title: The Mahabharata - The Dicing, The Sequel to the Dicing and The Temptation of Karna

vibeProfile.oneLine: The fateful dice game and other great episodes of the Mahabharata.

summary: Three of the most dramatic episodes from the Mahabharata, the vast Sanskrit epic of India: the fateful game of dice in which Yudhishthira gambles away his kingdom, his brothers, himself and their shared wife Draupadi; its terrible sequel; and the temptation of Karna. These sections turn on honour, fate and the seeds of the great war, and are among the epic's most powerful. A gripping way into the immense poem at the heart of Indian civilization.
whyReadIt: The most dramatic episodes of the Mahabharata, the dice game that dooms a kingdom. A gripping way into the great epic.

funFacts.text: The Mahabharata is one of the longest epic poems ever composed, many times the length of the Iliad and Odyssey combined.
